title: Reject incomplete and non-finite persisted trust-store schemas
description: P1 security (current post-520b state): TrustStorePersistence.load() still accepts an existing '{}' as a valid empty auto_pin=True store because root keys default, so truncation/partial semantic corruption silently erases every pin and re-enables TOFU. It also ignores unknown root/entry keys, accepts bool and NaN/Infinity timestamps via isinstance(int,float), leaves metadata key lengths/unbounded total JSON unchecked, and TrustEntry itself does not rederive/validate exact primitive types. Require exact versioned root/entry key sets with explicit auto_pin+entries, finite exact numeric timestamps, bounded keys/file size, and reject every incomplete/extra field before constructing any store.
